verdict.rationale: Event forwarding to third-party destinations is a fair question for an analytics platform, so the axis applies. The pack never shows Plausible streaming events onward. The Events API is inbound ingestion, the Stats API is a read-only query interface, exports are downloads, and Slack and email reports are scheduled summaries rather than registrable webhooks or CRM and ad-platform destinations. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform
